verdict.rationale: Bruno ships an official 'bru CLI' with documented commands to run collections/requests, generate JUnit/JSON/HTML reports, and integrate into CI/CD, plus official Docker images for pipeline use — this is a well-documented, first-party CLI suitable for automation/agentic workflows. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of CLI reliability/AI-native usage patterns, and no explicit mention of AI-agent-specific CLI features (e.g., structured JSON output for agent parsing) beyond general JSON reports.
